randomness: none in the evaluation; application identifiers are random but never decide ordering, scoring or hashes

environment.latency_basis: time.perf_counter around each complete retrieve() call (authorisation, note reads, ranking, link expansion and excerpts) in the machine that ran this script; not a measurement of any named target hardware

protocol.order: per query, rankings interleaved; ranking order alternates on each repeat
protocol.quality_from: first measured repeat; every later repeat must return identical evidence
protocol.limits: existing retrieve() limits: five sources and 6,000 excerpt characters
protocol.route_labels: retrieved_via values are copied from each packet; under the fts5 ranking, keyword_match means selected by the FTS5 ranking (packet ranking field is fts5)
protocol.irrelevant_definition: an evidence item whose note is not in the answer key, including link-expanded hubs that may still be useful context

comparison.basis: descriptive differences on this frozen synthetic set only; no significance test

limitations: Invented corpus and questions written by the evaluator; results do not transfer to private vaults.
Lexical support labels measure whether supporting notes reach the packet, not answer correctness, semantic quality or entailment.
Latency comes from this container and Python/SQLite build, not named target hardware.
No model, provider or network call; no new model experiment is implied.
Reviewed-memory statements are absent from this set, so only authored-note evidence is scored.
Permission leakage is checked for one ungranted source under strict read grants only.
